categories.COMMITTEE_OR_BOARD_FUNCTION: What a committee or board role does - responsibilities, powers, meeting practice. Inside the definition only if 'committee information' is read to include committee functions.
categories.COMPOSITION_FACT: A fact of the board's composition: its size or seats, which or how many directors are independent, which committees exist, who sits on or chairs them, and determinations about committee members' independence or qualifications.
categories.COMPOSITION_POLICY_OR_PROCESS: A policy, standard or process about composition: independence standards, voting standards, nomination and candidate criteria, evaluations, refreshment, overboarding limits. Inside the definition only if 'committee information' and 'board composition' are read to include how composition is governed.
categories.NOT_BOARD_COMPOSITION: Not board composition under any reading: executive or director compensation (including retainer labels), auditor services and independence, equity plan documents, insider trading and related-party procedures, shareholder outreach and communications, other companies' boards in biographies, labels without content, other governance topics.
